purpose: SP6c/SP6d: NEURON reproduction of the published Allen perisomatic fit 626170709 (human specimen 527952884, MTG layer 4 pyramidal) at two recorded inputs of its own recording session, with a dt-halving pair for the decision limits. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-07-h01-donor-allen-l4-import.md. Registered before any run; not started in the import task (the machine is shared by measured runs); stage 1 opens only when the user approves a window.
compile_first: docker run --rm -v <worktree>/.cache/human-pyramidal-l4/neuron-reference:/work -w /work braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 nrnivmodl .  (the eleven genome mod files, byte-identical to the L2 import; compiled once, x86_64/ stays in the cache)
input_datum: h01-l4-acquisition.json exports: sweep 69 (fit sweep, Square - 2s Suprathreshold, 100 pA, step 1020-3020 ms, bias -16.73 pA held, not injected: command-only input as in the L2 and PV findings) and sweep 39 (Long Square, 90 pA, step 1020-2020 ms, bias +2.33 pA held). Human -20 mV crossing counts 20 and 12 (= Allen num_spikes); sweep-69 repeats 69-72 give 20, 17, 19, 20; first crossings 32.18 ms and 33.88 ms after onset.

1.title: Published fit, unmodified, fixed step 0.005 ms (the L2 source-reproduction step), and its dt-halving repeat
1.prediction: Counts equal the Allen sweeps exactly: 20 at sweep 69 (100 pA, 2 s) and 12 at sweep 39 (90 pA, 1 s); first-spike latency within the dt-pair limit (|dt 0.005 - dt 0.0025| x 2.95) of 32.18 ms and 33.88 ms after step onset; every trace finite and time-ordered; the observed endpoint equals the requested stop.
1.rejection: A count differing from the Allen sweep by more than 1 at either input (17-20 is the human repeat band at 100 pA, so a model count outside it also fails the repeat row), or a dt pair whose count differs (numerics not converged: report 'time level open', no verdict).
1.unchanged: The eleven mod files, every value of 527952884_fit.json (sha256 1aa0e2c5...), 34 C, initial -80.81838607788086 mV (v_init), the recorded command waveform played from 0 ms, bias 0, two 30 um x 1 um axon sections replacing the reconstructed axon, nseg factor 1, no CVode, no candidate flag.
